title: finding(core/plugin-grid/plugin-map): the props channel is a SECOND, unruled carrier of an authored `data` — objectui#8348 judges `schema.data` and the prop bypasses it at higher priority
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) on ruling objectui#8348's open question 2. ⛔ Unassigned; grading and any `pm:*` state are triage's.

## What

objectui#8348 landed the maintainer's ruling 「以协议为准」 on the `record-source.ts` ladder: a block whose published `data` row is `z.array(...)` stops honouring the `{ provider, items }` object, and a block whose row is the `ViewData` object arm honours the object. That judges **`schema.data`**.

⚠️ **It is not the only carrier of the same authored key.** `SchemaRenderer` spreads every non-metadata node key as a React prop, so an authored `data` reaches a block **twice**:

| carrier | judged by the ladder? |
|---|---|
| `schema.data` | ✅ since objectui#8348 |
| the `data` **prop** | ❌ — `ObjectGrid` (`passedData`) and `ObjectMap` lift it with an unconditional `Array.isArray`, at **higher priority than the ladder** |

## Measured

⭐ Measured by the objectui#8348 dev seat on that PR's own head: on `object-grid` and `object-map`, **an authored bare array still draws through `SchemaRenderer` after objectui#8348**. The ruling bites on the schema carrier and not on the props carrier.

## Why objectui#8348 did not close it, and why that was right

The prop is how a **host** — `ListView`, say — hands down rows it already fetched. At the component boundary the authored key and the host key are **indistinguishable**: same name, same shape, same position. So gating the props channel on the same arm would delete a working host path in order to close an authoring gap. That trade was declined on objectui#8348 (PM ruling, option A) and this card exists so the gap is carded rather than remembered.

## The shape worth costing (⛔ not a ruling — this card is for one)

Stop `SchemaRenderer` spreading `data` as a **prop** for blocks whose published row is the object arm, so the authored key and the host key stop sharing one name **on those blocks**. That separates the two carriers instead of conflating or deleting either.

⚠️ Alternatives that should be priced beside it: a dedicated prop name for the host path, or a marker the host sets. ⛔ "Gate the props channel on the same arm" should be priced only with a distinguishable carrier introduced first.

## ⚠️ What is NOT in question

objectui#8348's own filed defect **is** closed end-to-end. `object-calendar`'s boundary keeps `data` only when `Array.isArray`, so the `{ provider, items }` config that card was about had exactly **one** carrier. This card is about the **generalisation** to `object-grid` and `object-map` being partial, not about the original fix being incomplete on its own subject.

## Adjacent, already named

objectui#7210 half 2 already owns the props-vs-schema boundary on these blocks, and `ObjectCalendar.recordSourceMembers-8314.test.tsx` documents the arrangement — with a warning that a pin written from the read that *looks* right cannot fail. ⭐ Whoever takes this should read that warning first: the obvious pin here is exactly the shape that passes without measuring anything.

## Dedup

⚠️ No duplicate sweep with a lit control was run for this card — REST `/search/*` answers 403 for this session by design. ⇒ there is **no** "no duplicate found" assertion here; the taker should check.
